* [simstim](_index.md)     - Run any coding agent on any host, and use it as if it ran here

* [simstim host restore](host_restore.md)     - Start again the sessions a host restart stopped (the host also does this at boot)
* [simstim host rm](host_rm.md)     - Forget a host (its sessions keep running)
* [simstim host start](host_start.md)     - Start the host through its provider or provider script
* [simstim host status](host_status.md)     - Ask the provider or provider script whether the host is running
* [simstim host stop](host_stop.md)     - Stop the host through its provider or provider script (a VM's sessions stop too; a sandbox's are paused)
